responsibility: This file expands boolean expression trees into target conditional-compare (CCMP) instruction sequences during GIMPLE-to-RTL expansion. It recognizes chains of same-block SSA comparisons combined with BIT_AND_EXPR or BIT_IOR_EXPR, recursively builds compare and conditional-compare instruction sequences through target hooks like gen_ccmp_first and gen_ccmp_next, cost-compares alternative orderings, and finally emits a cstore to materialize the boolean result. Its purpose is to map high-level combined comparisons onto CC-register-based conditional compare hardware support.
same_name_distinction: Implements the CCMP subsystem itself: it analyzes candidate GIMPLE boolean trees, recursively builds compare/conditional-compare RTL sequences through target hooks, and emits the final cstore. The paired header only declares the public entry point.
